The artifact cannot be approved: all bounded HTML reads ignore authoritative truncation, so the plan may extract from a partial search/product page and claim completeness. Revise the implementation while preserving EVERY accepted requirement, the caller interface, actual per-product navigation, workbook writing, output provenance and unconditional Browser cleanup. A structural revision is explicitly allowed to fix observation delivery; do not remove business operations or replace a produced file with a literal path.
Use the inspected producer contracts to obtain complete, bounded observations before action or extraction: when a snapshot exposes page cursors, consume its complete manifest with bounded existing foreach before navigation invalidates it. Guard capture/manifest completeness; narrowed reads are necessary when capture itself is truncated. Exhaustion or incomplete data must stop explicitly, never become an empty successful result. Avoid a large raw collection in global inference: retain only the compact business fields each consumer needs, keep exact action references in source bindings, and reuse typed selection or explicit independent extraction for unstructured fields. Every required page/item must be processed. Keep selection/ranking or synthesized status interpretation global on compact observations; extraction must return observed values, not invented classifications. Do not flatten, filter or deduplicate implicitly in independent extraction.
The existing ten-product bound, provider budgets, permissions, independent oracles, no startup confirmation and artifact approval remain unchanged. Do not rely on guessed site selectors or increase read/token limits. Keep the implementation concise and use only existing operations and TaskPlan constructs.
